title: A Study in Healthy Adults to Compare the Bioavailability of EPA + DHA From Two Microalgal Sources to One Fish Source and Placebo

sections.abstract: This is a randomised, double-blind, parallel, placebo-controlled study in healthy adults to compare the absorption of two microalgal formulations, to a fish oil and a placebo. Participant will take their assigned study product for 6 weeks and attend the clinic for 4 visits.
